plugins.name: Hornero Agenda

Shorter footnote so it is not clipped at the bottom of the widget.

PluginKit 3 desktop widget on Hornero Signal: host-owned frame, position and size (sizeClass and showOnDesktop settings removed); day readout, ISO week/quarter/day-of-year readouts and a year partition bar with a dimension line.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.

Desktop Widgets 2.0 (#32): manifest v2 with the desktop surface redeclared on the same entrypoint, read-only Desktop.position slot and display shown in a host-owned popover, persisted compact/standard/wide size class and hide-with-restore visibility as typed settings (defaults standard/visible, so 2.0 content is unchanged), and reset for size and visibility. Time and Agenda 2.0: the 1.x date facts as labelled metrics plus quarter, ISO week-year, days remaining in the month and a year-progress bar, locale-correct dates and numbers, typed row settings with 1.x defaults and Argentine Spanish catalog. No events are shown: PluginKit has no calendar data source.

plugins.name: Hornero AI Usage
plugins.description: Agent Deck: every discovered coding-agent subscription in one place - provider-reported quota windows with resets, plans, and local activity. Unavailable quotas are labelled unknown, never guessed.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warningPercent.description: Quota used percent that counts as approaching a limit.

statsWindow.description: Activity window for Agent Deck daily statistics.

changelog.notes: Optional governed companion reaction when a verified quota crosses the warning threshold, and the All window now states it means all available daily history (up to 90 days).

Holistic daily statistics with an activity-window selector (7/30/60/90/all, segmented on wide screens, dropdown when compact): an all-agents daily chart and windowed per-provider totals over the backend's 90-day real buckets, filtered locally from cached records.

Agents page scrolls inside the room the dashboard offers, uses the full width with two-column instrument modules, and charts real per-day token activity (horneroctl recentDays) plus an in/out/cache partition. No invented series.
Fix quota windows collapsing to the legacy single meter: JSON arrays lose Array identity across QML property boundaries, so every provider window now renders (live-host find).

Agent Deck (PluginKit 5): a top-level Agents dashboard page, real subscription quota windows with reset countdowns (Claude Code, Codex, Muse Code, Cursor) over horneroctl schema v2, a tightest-quota bar indicator, and a richer popover. Needs a PluginKit 5 shell and a horneroctl with agent usage schema v2; older backends keep the legacy fallback.
Catalogue description no longer leads with an internal version; it says what the extension does first.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: instrument module header and a segmented quota meter that appears only when the provider reports a limit; quota stays unknown otherwise.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.

maxChars.description: Never record a copy longer than this many characters.

excludeWords.description: Comma-separated words; a copy containing any of them (case-insensitive) is never recorded.

skipSensitive.description: Skip copies that a password manager marks as secret (x-kde-passwordManagerHint).
